_why: The commons router table (PROGRAMME_GOVERNANCE 3.12, LEAN CA-06 in JSON). Commons rows are edited on main only. Programmes add rows in router/intents.d/{map,brain,upstream}.json; a station adds router/intents.d/station.json (contributed_by: station) and router/skills.json (skill fall-through). Keywords are frozen before selftest prompts are written and never widened to fit one. The tie rule has ONE owner: this file.

intents.name: build
intents.description: make a new tool, skill, hook, check or workflow

first_move.args: the build item, after the prior-art gather

intents.name: governance-admin
intents.description: change or question a rule, decision, ledger row, defect or owner

first_move.args: then read the owner file named in governance/OWNERSHIP.md

intents.name: closeout
intents.description: close a work pass, rate it, pick the next step

intents.name: handoff
intents.description: hand the work to a fresh session (context running out, stopping mid-task)

intents.name: checkpoint
intents.description: record a checkpoint the moment work becomes durable (a commit landed, a slice accepted)

intents.name: delegate
intents.description: spawn subagents, fan out, run or write a workflow

router_tie_rule.reason: cost if the gather is SKIPPED, highest first: a station's live-surface intent (station:* = every contributed_by station row, and on main every kit_tree leaf) can touch money, clients or a quarantined tree; a skipped ingest lands unneutralised upstream agent files; a skipped find rebuilds what exists; governance-admin edits a rule without its owner; build without prior art; recall re-derives a known result; a skipped handoff loses the session's state; delegate without /summon multiplies every mistake; a skipped checkpoint loses the durable record of a commit; closeout, where and map-regen cost one re-run. reconcile-01 (DEC-core-0011): site-protection (a skipped gather probes a host the operator may not own), shared-market-scan (an unsourced number reaches a deliverable) and design-review (a build ships unmeasured) sit after build. understand (DEC-core-0012) follows: a skipped gather re-indexes a target or reads a stale memory.
router_tie_rule._why_doc: CRITIC F2 (2026-10-16): the cap refused one-sentence prompts ('build an MVP for my invoicing venture'). It now applies only when the prompt looks like a pasted document: >= doc_min_newlines newlines, or >= doc_min_clauses clauses AND > doc_min_chars characters. Below that the matched intents are ranked (order, claims, hits).
